# Minimax

> > Global leader in fire protection systems, detection technologies, and suppression control solutions for industrial, commercial, and marine applications.

Minimax, founded in 1902 by Wilhelm Graaff in Bad Oldesloe, Germany, is part of the Minimax Viking Group and operates across 30+ countries. The company specializes in advanced fire safety technologies including UniVario and HELIOS detection systems, MiniFog water mist solutions, and comprehensive fire protection for industries ranging from automotive and energy to data centers and marine vessels.

## Key Topics

- UniVario fire detection system
- HELIOS suppression control
- MiniFog water mist systems
- Minimax Viking Group
- Fire suppression control
- Aspirating smoke detectors
- Industrial fire protection
- Marine fire protection (IMO-compliant)
- Sprinkler systems
- Data center fire safety
- Power plant protection
- Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- PVProtect photovoltaic systems
- Maintenance services
- Fire detection technologies
